snippet.title: Hytale | Creative Mode Gameplay (27 Minutes)
snippet.description:
Nearly 30 minutes of Hytale's Creative Mode gameplay that was featured in our latest blog post. Ktar demonstrates the versatility and wide-range of creative tools that will be available at Hytale's Early Access release. 
http://www.hytale.com
